name: get_access_to_vercel_url
description: Create or reuse a shareable link for a protected Vercel deployment that the user's Vercel account can access. Returns the deployment URL with a '_vercel_share' parameter. If no valid share link exists, one is created on the deployment, and anyone with the URL can view the deployment until it expires. New links expire in 23 hours; existing valid links keep their expiration and may not expire. Opening the URL redirects and sets an auth cookie; for clients without cookie support, web_fetch_vercel_url fetches the content directly.

teamId.description: The team ID or slug that owns the deployment. Provide this for team deployments so the lookup uses the correct scope. Use list_teams if unknown.

url.description: The full URL of the Vercel deployment (e.g. "https://myapp.vercel.app").
